name: benchmark-vidore-v3-computer-science
description: A benchmark of computer-science–focused questions and problems intended to evaluate models' knowledge and reasoning in CS topics (e.g., algorithms, systems, theory). Items include multiple-choice and open-answer questions that test factual knowledge and problem-solving. It measures accuracy and correctness on domain-specific CS tasks.
reputation: A niche dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing use for evaluating CS knowledge in language models.
